thread:
Sam B: Morning team — noticed a wave of 20-60s owner flips last night in APAC. many are lead.assign -> enrichment.retry -> reassign loop.
Lina K: saw it too. our RR window (22s) + HS webhook retries is the culprit. we need a graceful approach not just longer timeouts.
Marcus D: Proposal: introduce a "grace window" per-lead after first assignment. During grace window: block auto-reassigns and aggregate enrichment updates. default 90s with exponential backoff for repeated churn.
Priya N: +1. Also add a circuit-breaker at the region level: if reassign rate > threshold for 5m, flip region to "manual-handoff" mode and route new leads to manual queue.
Sam B: Manual queue idea is good. ops can triage and rerun enrichment for manual items. For automation: set lead.property owner_hold_reason = 'grace' or 'circuit_breaker' so SDRs can filter.
Lina K: For HubSpot, quick workflow stub: 
```
IF recent_owner_change_count > 1 AND hours_since_create < 1 THEN set owner_hold_reason = 'grace' AND set assign_mode = 'hold'
```
This prevents RR from touching it until hold expires.
Marcus D: CRM write guard: write_owner only if last_owner_write_ts is null OR now - last_owner_write_ts > grace_window. Also include idempotency token from assignment service.
Priya N: Circuit-breaker thresholds: region_reassign_rate > 10/hr OR percent_flapping_leads > 3% -> enter manual-handoff. Ops playbook: 1) run enrichment rehydrate on queued leads 2) notify #sales-inbound with samples 3) optionally open a temporary SDR rota for manual triage.
Sam B: Observability: add metrics handoff.grace_hits, handoff.region_circuit_state, handoff.manual_queue_depth, and alert if manual_queue_depth > 200.
Lina K: Rollout plan: feature flag "handoff_grace_and_cb". Canary small region nights 48h. Success: reduce owner flips >= 50% AND manual-handling latency < 30m 80th. fallback: rollback flag.
Marcus D: PR body proposal: "handoff grace window + region circuit-breaker: prevents immediate reassigns and provides manual queue fallback during noisy enrichment periods. Adds HubSpot property owner_hold_reason, idempotent CRM writes, and metrics. Feature-flagged; canary to APAC nights"
Priya N: ops-bot: please create feature flag and wire an alert rule for region_reassign_rate and manual_queue_depth.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: handoff_grace_and_cb (default=false). Monitors created: marketing.handoff.region_reassign_rate, marketing.handoff.manual_queue_depth.
SDR-bot: [automated] Sample manual queue entry: lead 83217 (email alice@example.com) assigned_hold: grace reason: enrichment_retry count: 3.
Sam B: Quick sync 10m to assign PR owners and mock dashboard. Lina will handle HS workflow patch; Marcus will own CRM write guard and tests. Priya will draft ops playbook and alerts.
Lina K: I'll prepare HubSpot workflow and a fallback that sets assign_mode back to 'auto' after hold expires.
Marcus D: I'll add idempotency tests and a short integration that simulates webhook retries.
Priya N: goal: keep SLAs intact while reducing noisy reassigns. if canary hits objectives, widen rollout in 72h.
Sam B: Thanks all — post-canary metrics in this thread. :thumbsup:
